strategy_roster.name: CCI Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: CCI and Momentum are unavailable, so a 20-bar z-score above 1.64 is the positive extreme breakout proxy and a return below zero exits. The documented 2% stop is retained; the short side and intraday timing are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Bearish Wick Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: A bearish candle with a lower wick at least 1% below its close captures the documented threshold; the prior candle high is the close-based exit. The optional EMA(200) filter is disabled and the time window is unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Time Candles
strategy_roster.notes: The document explicitly describes visualization-only RSI/SMA candles with no entry, exit, or direction logic. An impossible negative-price guard avoids fabricating a trade signal.

strategy_roster.name: ADX System DI Cross
strategy_roster.notes: The permitted ADX(14) aggregate and positive one-bar ROC proxy the +DI-above-ADX long condition; weakening ADX or momentum exits. DI components, point stops, trailing, and the short side are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: RNN Probability
strategy_roster.notes: The documented default Open price and RSI(9) are retained, but the weighted RNN lattice is unavailable; an RSI midpoint cross is a transparent probability proxy. Pip protection, short entries, and the hand-crafted weights are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Bull Row Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,20) and close > open and roc(close,1) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish break above the prior 20-bar high with positive one-bar momentum proxies the bearish-row, bullish-momentum breakout. Stochastic filters, row sizing, dynamic price-step risk, and short behavior are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Donchian Rsi
strategy_roster.notes: Prior 20-bar Donchian levels and the documented RSI(14) 30/70 thresholds are retained, including the unusual oversold long breakout rule. The opposite range/RSI condition exits; the short side and intraday context are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Billy Expert
strategy_roster.notes: Positive four-bar momentum above SMA(20) is a current-timeframe proxy for the four-descending-high pattern and stochastic confirmation. The two stochastic timeframes, candle-row logic, and point stops are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Pending Order Grid
strategy_roster.notes: A prior ten-bar high break is a state-free proxy for a pending stop grid; the mirrored low break exits. Order-book offsets, volume scaling, martingale layers, and tick-based protection are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Box (Pseudo Grid Bot)
strategy_roster.notes: An RSI(14) oversold event followed within five bars by a close above SMA(20) proxies the recalculated long grid. Dynamic highest/lowest grid levels, optional shorts, and the time window are unavailable.
